channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation preserves historic Crain Estate in Fort Pierce with global artist residency program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is establishing Fort Pierce as a vibrant artistic hub by preserving the historic Crain Estate and connecting artists from around the world. item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% this year
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Delray Beach elementary school jumps from 'C' to 'A' rating
item.description: S.D. Spady Elementary School in Delray Beach made a dramatic leap from a 'C' rating last year to an 'A' this year, reflecting a turnaround effort led by Principal Rona Tata.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic to South Florida roads
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans traveled at least 50 miles from home between Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, July 5, marking an all-time high for the holiday, with 61.4 million making the trip by car.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive 'A' rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County has earned an "A" rating from the Florida Department of Education for the third consecutive year, reflecting strong student performance across all grade levels. item.title: Palm Beach County Fire Rescue responds to 29 fires overnight during Fourth of July
item.description: Fire crews responded to 29 fires across Palm Beach County during the overnight hours of the Fourth of July holiday, with brush fires and trash fires accounting for most incidents.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description:
A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. The crash happened around 2 a.m. near State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. The city was the only Florida community selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council to vote on land transfer for Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at Midway Road and Florida's Turnpike. Final approval will come at an upcoming meeting.

item.title: Fort Pierce breast cancer patient speaks out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her insurance company deny coverage for breast reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. Her insurer, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, said the surgical mesh is investigational and not FDA-approved for breast reconstruction.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation attracts global artists to Fort Pierce with residency program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce is transforming the city into an artistic destination through its artist-in-residency program and art classes. The foundation operates on the historic Crain Estate where Jaxson and Mary Crain once lived.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit rescued two boaters on July 1 after their small motorized boat took on water and became submerged in the Intracoastal Waterway. Both occupants were wearing life jackets that kept them afloat until help arrived.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation that doubles slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation project designed to nearly double its capacity. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her Wimbledon doubles match with sister Venus on Saturday because of a right knee injury suffered during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time to advance to World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 Friday in a World Cup match that went to extra time, with the winning goal coming off a deflection in the 111th minute.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football aims for state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is setting its sights on a state title heading into the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district championship. item.description:

item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events
item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse hosted Independence Day activities on July 4, including a pool party, live music and fireworks to mark the nation's 250th anniversary.

item.title: DeSantis vetoes sovereign immunity bill that would have raised damages caps for government negligence victims
item.description: Governor Ron DeSantis vetoed legislation that would have increased damages caps for people injured by government negligence, rejecting the first such increase to pass the Florida Legislature in 16 years. item.title: DeSantis allies accuse Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins' wife of running anonymous accounts attacking governor
item.description: Multiple anonymous social media accounts were deactivated after prominent DeSantis communications veterans traced them to phone and email information matching Layla Collins, wife of Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins.

item.title: FEMA awards $7.2 million to four Florida municipalities for Hurricane Ian infrastructure projects
item.description: FloridaCommerce announced a new round of grants to help communities impacted by Hurricane Ian in September 2022, bringing total Ian recovery funding to more than $12 million.

item.title: Secretary of State Byrd asks court to keep Paula Stark off ballot after filing deadline error
item.description: Five state employees dispute St. Cloud Republican Paula Stark's account of a paperwork mix-up that left her missing a required Form 6 less than 30 minutes before the qualifying deadline.

item.title: Supreme Court preserves grace period laws for counting absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that states may count absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day but received afterward, providing clarity for Florida election administrators.

item.title: U.S. men's national soccer team faces Belgium in World Cup Round of 16 after historic knockout victory
item.description: The United States earned its first knockout stage victory since 2002 with a 2-0 win over Bosnia and Herzegovina, but will face Belgium without star player Folarin Balogun, who was red-carded.
